answer_1.quote: Introduction of a new, context-aware dataset for Javadoc generation, covering methods, lambdas, and modern Java features... Systematic evaluation and fine-tuning of five publicly available LLMs (LLaMA-3.1, Gemma-2, Phi-3, Mistral, Qwen-2.5) on the proposed Javadoc generation task.

answer_2.quote: To assess the quality of the generated documentation, we employed a set of standard, well-established metrics. We used the BLEU score to measure the precision of n-gram overlap between the generated and reference documentation. Additionally, we used several variants of the ROUGE score (R-1, R-2, R-L, and R-Lsum) to evaluate content overlap by assessing recall on unigrams, bigrams, and the longest common subsequence.
